## Messages

| Field     | Type   | Required |
| --------- | ------ | -------- |
| `jsonrpc` | string | yes      |
| `id`      | number | no       |

### `_meta`

Reserved for metadata.

### `tasks/get`

Retrieves a task. See the [schema](../schema#calltoolrequest).
